notes: A public-API translation of the native-green 128-assertion HLA_EVOKED three-member explicit-source regional interaction restore case. One adapter-configured source region overlaps two independently constrained regional subscribers; an untimed save captures their pending timestamped interaction copies and the retraction ledger. Post-save Retract terminalizes the live designator; restore recovers both copies and live retraction state. Independent Flush Queue Requests deliver source-region-preserving callbacks before each grant, and a later Retract notifies both recipients. Isolated C++ primary/contract passed using only installed 2026-10-20 package libraries with integer64 and float64 time. The adapter supplies provider libraries, endpoint, IEEE 1516.2-2025 DDM FOM, interaction class, parameter, two dimensions, logical-time implementation, and HLA_EVOKED callback model. Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR; Java provider runtime, HLA_IMMEDIATE, durable/process-boundary restore, interoperability, and conformance are unverified.
